tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: Fetch the current Hacker News front page (top stories) via the official Firebase API. Use when the user asks for top, front, or trending stories.

tools.name: new_stories
tools.description: Fetch newest Hacker News story submissions. Use when the user asks for new or latest posts.

tools.name: best_stories
tools.description: Fetch best-ranked Hacker News stories. Use when the user asks for best posts or all-time greats on the best feed.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one Hacker News item (story or comment thread) by numeric id, including top-level comments when available.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Look up a Hacker News user profile (karma, about, created date) by username.

tools.name: browse_feed
tools.description: Browse an HTML feed on news.ycombinator.com: news, newest, ask, show, jobs, newcomments, front, or best.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories via the public Algolia API (same backend as hn.algolia.com).

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Hacker News with username and password. Stores session cookie in hn_session_cookie for upvote, comment, and submit.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Check whether hn_session_cookie is present and still logged in on Hacker News.

tools.name: upvote
tools.description: Upvote a story or comment by item id. Requires a valid hn_session_cookie from login.

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a story or reply thread. parent_id is the story or comment id. Requires login session.

tools.name: submit_story
tools.description: Submit a new story link or Ask HN text post. Requires login. Provide story_url for link posts or story_text for text posts.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login" references sensitive artifacts (password, cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Sign in to Hacker News with username and password. Stores session cookie in hn_session_cookie for upvote, comment, and submit.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-hacker_news" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: new_stories, best_stories, get_item, browse_feed · Private data: login · Public sink: login, post_comment, submit_story.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: new_stories, best_stories, get_item, browse_feed · Private data: login · Public sink: login, post_comment, submit_story

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
